It's great that you're feeling better! As you prefer to take an active role in your medical decisions – choosing the 'present' role – let's explore stopping your antibiotics early. Generally, it's really important to finish the full course of antibiotics your doctor prescribed, even if you're feeling much improved. Stopping early can sometimes allow remaining bacteria to develop resistance to the antibiotic, making future infections harder to treat. However, I understand that feeling better can make you question continuing, and it's good you're considering this. To help you make an informed decision, I strongly recommend discussing this directly with your doctor or pharmacist. They can assess your specific situation, considering the type of infection, the antibiotic used, and your overall health, and provide personalized advice. They can also address any anxieties you might have about continuing the medication. Please don't adjust your dosage or stop taking the antibiotics without consulting them first.
